where: verify/evidence.js targetNeeds: the "(excluding …)" override skipped on an or-target TARGET
why: Correct for Archagonists, and every bite I tried still fails: Archagonists needs +none:[Monster], +Monster, or the Slaanesh dropped; Retreat Below +Burrower; Hypersensory Scillia without Infantry; The Realm of Chaos +none:[Monster]. An exclusion that no other alternative cancels also still fails as unparsed (derive.js returns none): an exclusion on either alternative of Retreat Below, “(excluding MONSTERS and VEHICLES)”, “(excluding MONSTERS and CHARACTERS)”, “(excluding PINK HORRORS)”. Only Archagonists is affected today (it is the only or-target TARGET with “(excluding”). The problem is that the skip hands the whole case to derive.js's cancellation rule, which is too broad: a keyword is dropped from every alternative whenever any alternative has it. That is right only when the alternatives are S+K and S excluding K, so their union is S. Tested in a scratch copy: the TARGET “One LEGIONES DAEMONICA MONSTER unit or up to two LEGIONES DAEMONICA SLAANESH units (excluding MONSTERS)” with needs {all:[Faction: Legiones Daemonica]} now passes the whole evidence step. That needs offers the stratagem to Khorne Infantry, which GW excludes. Main's override would have flagged it (as a mismatch). derive.js gives “…SLAANESH MONSTER … or … KHORNE units (excluding MONSTERS)” as any:[Slaanesh, Khorne], which also lets in Slaanesh non-Monsters and Khorne Monsters. Fix: cancel (and skip the override) only when one alternative's keywords minus K equal the other's and the other excludes exactly K; anything else stays unparsed. Put the check in derive.js or-target, and keep the evidence.js skip conditional on it.

where: Chaos Daemons · Legion of Excess · Archagonists needs
why: GW (verify/.cache/waha and cat-cache, identical): “One LEGIONES DAEMONICA SLAANESH MONSTER unit or up to two LEGIONES DAEMONICA SLAANESH units (excluding MONSTERS)”. That is Slaanesh Monster ∪ Slaanesh non-Monster = every Slaanesh unit, so {all:[Faction: Legiones Daemonica, Slaanesh]} is exactly the union. Adding none:[Monster] (main's override) would wrongly drop the first alternative.

where: BOXES s|1pislf8 Adeptus Custodes · Guardians of the Throne · Shield of Honour
why: GW: “When an enemy model engaged with your unit selects targets, if that enemy model does not select your unit … that enemy model’s attacks have: -1 to hit rolls. -1 to wound rolls.” That is a penalty on the enemy's attacks, but the box gives hit -1 and wound -1 to the Custodes unit's own melee attacks (behind two q toggles). The cause: effects-extract.js DEFENCE does not read a lead “that enemy model’s attacks have:” over list lines. Fix it in DEFENCE (or the lead handling) so this goes to nc / no box. The rule is general, not a hand entry.

where: BOXES s|jmtnfy Tyranids · Subterranean Assault · Enfilading Emergence
why: GW: WHEN “End of your Movement phase”, EFFECT “Until the end of your next Fight phase, weapons equipped by models in your unit have [SUSTAINED HITS 1] and [IGNORES COVER]”. That covers the Shooting phase in between too, and “weapons” means ranged and melee. The box has kind:'melee' because kindOf sees “fight phase” in the duration, so its ranged attacks lose both, and Ignores Cover does nothing in melee. It should be kind:'all'. kindOf should not read a phase named in an “until the end of …” duration as the kind.

where: BOXES s|kj5cu3 / s|15l8sj / s|n3dvjc: a target-status condition dropped (Counterpredation, Psy-Chaff Volley, Draught of Terror)
why: Three new boxes lose the condition GW puts on the target, so the Damage tab counts the effect unconditionally. Counterpredation: “attacks that target a hidden unit have +1 S and AP”, on:[]. Psy-Chaff Volley: “Attacks that target a prosecuted unit have +1 AP”, on:[]. Also, its WHEN is “has shot”, so the benefit is for other units' attacks (all attacks, not only ranged) against the prosecuted unit, not for the Prosecutors' own attacks, which are already made. Draught of Terror, 2nd sentence: “each time such a weapon targets a unit that is Battle-shocked, you can re-roll the Wound roll”, on:[]. Compare Tip of the Talon and Slayers of Nightmares, which get a q condition from QP. Fix: QP or COND should read “that target(s) a **<status>** unit” and “targets a unit that is <status>” as a q condition. For Psy-Chaff Volley, either a reach to friendly units or nc. These come from general rules, not hand entries, but G4/G5 do not catch a missing condition.
